name: Archboard announcements
responsibility: Archboard's board changes, focus and selection, worded for the coordinator and the voice and announced through the voice agent
description: The voice hears the news of a board on screen, as speech when it stops the narration, and nothing of a board no pane shows. The coordinator hears only what an agent outside the session did: a board it wrote, or a pane it moved with browser show. A focus or selection the user made carries a topic, so a later one replaces it while it waits.
